title: What a bounded grant does and does not cover

evaluations.label: Hold at 10:03 under the standing hold grant
evaluations.why: The hold is inside the class: permitted action, any invoice, permitted parameters, allowance unused.

evaluations.label: A second hold of the same invoice at 10:10
evaluations.why: The first hold already moved the invoice out of the open state, so the precondition no longer holds.

reasons.message: PRE-INVOICE-OPEN is not satisfied: Invoice INV-2026-0417 is open (not already held or paid).

evaluations.label: The hold grant used to release a payment
evaluations.why: A grant covers exactly what it names. Release is not a hold, and its parameters are not the grant's parameters.

reasons.message: action release_payment is outside the grant
parameter amount_eur (number) is not permitted by the grant
parameter currency (string) is not permitted by the grant
parameter payment_run (string) is not permitted by the grant
SCR-S1042 v1 is 50.8 h old; policy allows 24 h
PRE-MATCH-PASS is not satisfied: A current three-way match result for the invoice is PASS.
PRE-SCREEN-FRESH is not satisfied: Supplier screening is at most 24 hours old.

evaluations.label: A hold on a purchase order, which the class does not cover
evaluations.why: The class covers invoices. A different kind of target is outside it, even for the same action.

reasons.message: target INV-2026-0417 is outside the grant

evaluations.label: A precondition that nobody defined
evaluations.why: A precondition with no rule cannot be shown to hold, so the action does not proceed.

reasons.message: no rule is defined for PRE-UNDEFINED-9

evaluations.label: An attempt timed before the grant was issued
evaluations.why: Everything the attempt rests on comes later than the attempt: the grant's issuance, its revocation check and the evidence admitted afterwards. Nothing that happens after an attempt can authorize it.

reasons.message: the only revocation check on record ('not_revoked' at 2026-11-23T07:45:00Z) came after the attempt, so it cannot show that grant GRT-CLASS-HOLD v1 was unrevoked then
INV-2026-0417 v1 was admitted at 2026-11-23T07:31:00Z, after the attempt
M3W-0417 v1 was admitted at 2026-11-23T09:36:00Z, after the attempt
PRE-INVOICE-OPEN is not satisfied: Invoice INV-2026-0417 is open (not already held or paid).

evaluations.label: A hold at 09:30, before the match result was admitted
evaluations.why: The hold rests on the match result, which was admitted at 09:36. At 09:30 the gateway could not rely on it, however correct it later proved to be.

reasons.message: M3W-0417 v1 was admitted at 2026-11-23T09:36:00Z, after the attempt

evaluations.label: A hold at 10:03 when the only revocation check was made at 10:04
evaluations.why: A check that says the grant is unrevoked cannot authorize an attempt made before the check was recorded.

reasons.message: the only revocation check on record ('not_revoked' at 2026-11-23T10:04:00Z) came after the attempt, so it cannot show that grant GRT-CLASS-HOLD v1 was unrevoked then

note: Stored what-if evaluations of the reference commit check. Overrides are applied in memory only; nothing is executed.
